Many senses marked inferred/guess (the lots speech, cat choconic / cat taquentah, Cat quix la vloc, the wooden people's lacks, xcut / xcute). Glosser on Sonnet; drafter and both review passes on the routine's model. Seven house renderings added to conventions.md.
